title.zh: 画布一次能拖进一堆素材了
title.en: Drop a pile of files into the canvas at once

items.zh: 画布可以一次拖入多个文件、直接粘贴图片，导入过程有进度提示，不用再一张张来
items.en: The canvas accepts multiple files at once and pasted images show import progress, instead of one file at a time

items.zh: 别人分享的画布包，即使里面引用了已删除的素材也能正常打开，不会再导入失败
items.en: Shared canvas packages now open even when they reference deleted assets, instead of failing to import

items.zh: 画布节点里打字、复制粘贴不会误删节点，选中多个节点后复制粘贴也更顺手
items.en: Typing or pasting inside a node no longer deletes it, and copy/paste with several nodes selected works as expected

title.zh: 参考图能带上了，全能参考不再卡在第一步
title.en: Reference images now go through, all-reference mode no longer stalls

items.zh: 星辰AI 的全能参考型号可以正常带参考图、参考音频生成，不再报「参考素材上传失败」
items.en: Aliyun-style all-reference models on 星辰AI now accept reference images and audio instead of failing at the upload step

items.zh: 参考图或参考音频超过 10MB 时，提交前就会提示，省掉一次白跑
items.en: Files over 10MB are flagged before submission, so you no longer wait for a failed run

items.zh: 还没接入素材云存储时，参考视频会直接说明需要接入，而不是给一个看不懂的报错
items.en: Without asset cloud storage, reference videos now state exactly what is missing instead of a cryptic error

title.zh: 视频模型选得到了，也跑得通
title.en: Video models are now selectable and actually run

items.zh: 星辰AI 的 seedance 2.5 / 2.0、万相 3.0 各型号补齐：视频节点的模型下拉里都能选到了
items.en: Seedance 2.5 / 2.0 and Wan 3.0 variants from 星辰AI now appear in the video node model menu

items.zh: 文生、首尾帧、参考生、全能参考按型号自动区分，选好型号后比例、分辨率、时长只给你能用的值
items.en: Text, first/last frame, reference, and all-reference modes come from the model itself; ratio, resolution, and duration only offer supported values

items.zh: 「模型设置」新增「视频生成」，可以指定默认视频模型，新开的视频节点会自动带上它
items.en: Model Settings now has Video Generation; new video nodes start with your default video model

items.zh: 万相型号会自动带上站点要求的版本参数，参考图按站点字段名提交，减少提交即报错的来回
items.en: Wan models send the required version field and use the site's own reference field names, cutting failed submissions

title.zh: 自动沉淀更稳了，写起来更顺
title.en: Auto-settling is steadier and typing stays smooth

items.zh: 已发布的章节改完正文后，仍然保持「已发布」，不会被当成没写完的稿子
items.en: Published chapters stay published after you edit them

items.zh: 你自己整理过或让 AI 整理过的章内事件，不会再被自动总结覆盖
items.en: Event lists you or the AI already wrote are never overwritten by auto-summary

items.zh: 大章节边写边存更顺：只改几个字时不会每次都重算一遍梗概
items.en: Long chapters no longer recompute the brief on every small edit

items.zh: 「骨架看板」的已沉淀、已发布统计更准，正在写的章节不会再被算成已完成
items.en: Skeleton board tallies settled and published chapters correctly

title.zh: 写完就自动沉淀，还能一眼看完整本书的骨架
title.en: Chapters settle themselves, and the whole skeleton is now visible

items.zh: 保存正文后自动生成章节梗概、章内事件、紧张度与情绪标签，不用再手动跑一次总结
items.en: Saving a chapter now produces its brief, inner events, tension and emotion tags automatically

items.zh: 梗概是从你这章正文里原样抽出来的句子，不调 AI、不联网，也不会编出没写过的情节
items.en: Briefs are sentences extracted straight from your own text — no AI call, no invented plot

items.zh: 你自己写的或让 AI 写过的章节总结不会被覆盖，只把状态补成已沉淀
items.en: Briefs you wrote yourself, or had the AI write, are never overwritten

items.zh: 概览页新增「骨架看板」：按卷看每一章的梗概、字数和状态，缺章纲、待沉淀、字数偏少都会标出来
items.en: New Skeleton Board on the overview page: every chapter's brief, word count and state, with missing outlines and unsettled chapters flagged

items.zh: 章节状态会从草稿自动推进到已沉淀，概览页的缺口也跟着实时减少
items.en: Chapter state advances from draft to settled automatically, and the overview gap list shrinks in real time

title.zh: 8 个快捷动作，从一句话变成一整套方法
title.en: The eight shortcut actions now carry full instructions

items.zh: 「生成章纲」「生成正文」「润色本章」「总结本章」「生成角色弧光」「扩写设定」「设计兑现方案」「生成全书创作规划」8 个动作全部换成完整提示词，原来每条只有一句话
items.en: All eight built-in actions now use full prompts instead of one-liners

items.zh: 生成正文会先校准大纲与前文，再给场景清单：章末钩子、伏笔、人物声音、字数范围都有硬要求
items.en: Drafting now verifies the outline and previous chapters first, then works from a scene list with hard rules on hooks, foreshadowing, voice and length

items.zh: 润色本章按 12 类 AI 腔清单逐条清，明确不动剧情、不改伏笔、不换章末钩子
items.en: Polishing clears twelve AI-writing habits while leaving plot, foreshadowing and the chapter hook untouched

items.zh: 角色弧光给到伤口、错误信念、想要与需要的错位、三个关键节点和六道压力测试；伏笔给三个机制不同的兑现方案并逐个评风险
items.en: Character arcs now cover the wound, the lie, want versus need, three turning points and six pressure tests; foreshadowing gets three distinct payoff plans with risk notes

items.zh: 你自己改过的内置提示词不会被覆盖，没改过的会在升级后自动换成新版
items.en: Your edited built-in prompts are preserved; untouched ones upgrade automatically

title.zh: 开书骨架补齐了，更新也不用你自己猜
title.en: Full skeleton for new books, and updates now tell you what changed

items.zh: 一键开书先搭好整个骨架：世界观 5 条、核心角色 6–8 张，每张写满九项设定，动机、秘密、成长线、说话习惯都在
items.en: Setup lays the full skeleton first: five worldbuilding entries and 6–8 core characters, each with nine fields

items.zh: 每一卷都有一份卷合同：从哪开始、到哪结束、什么必须发生、什么不许提前写完，一次说清
items.en: Every volume gets a contract: where it starts, where it ends, what must happen, what may not be resolved early

items.zh: 每一卷的每一章都有标题和梗概，不再是清一色的「第 X 章」
items.en: Every chapter in every volume now has a title and a synopsis

items.zh: 概览页直接列出还缺什么——缺卷合同、缺章节标题、当前卷缺章纲，看到就能补
items.en: The overview page lists what is still missing, so you can fill it in right away

items.zh: 「按卷补章」一次把当前这一卷排到位，最多 35 章，每章自动带上六项章纲
items.en: Fill chapters by volume: plan a whole volume at once, up to 35 chapters with six-field outlines
